meta.name: baoyu-url-to-markdown
meta.description: Fetch any URL and convert to markdown using Chrome CDP. Supports two modes - auto-capture on page load, or wait for user signal (for pages requiring login). Use when user wants to save a webpage as markdown.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意网页转为 Markdown 格式保存
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要把网页内容保存为 Markdown 格式
copy.tagline_en: Convert any webpage to Markdown format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to save web pages as Markdown

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 可以抓取任意网址,用 Chrome 完整渲染页面,把 HTML 转成带元信息(标题、作者、时间等)的 Markdown 文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求把某个网页保存成 Markdown 文件时触发。默认自动抓取,需要登录或动态加载的页面可用等待模式。

say.text: 把 https://example.com 保存成 Markdown。
say.note: 自动模式,抓取并生成 Markdown 文件。

say.text: 用等待模式抓取这个需要登录的页面:https://example.com
say.note: 会先等你说准备好了再抓取。

say.text: 抓取 https://example.com 并保存为 output.md。

howto.what_en: Fetches any URL via Chrome CDP, renders the page with Chrome, and converts HTML to clean markdown with metadata (url, title, author, etc.).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to save a webpage as a markdown file. Default auto mode captures on page load; wait mode is for login-required or dynamic pages.

say_en.note: Auto mode, fetches and generates a Markdown file.

say_en.text: Use wait mode to fetch this login-required page: https://example.com
say_en.note: It will wait until you say it's ready.

say_en.text: Fetch https://example.com and save as output.md.
say_en.note: Outputs to a specified file name.
